headline: BOS @ TBR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BOS 4.73 at TBR 3.04, with a projected total of 7.77. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: BOS moved -0.03 runs while TBR moved -0.94, changing the projected margin by +0.91 runs. The projected total fell -0.97, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Nick Martinez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Yandy Díaz, Junior Caminero, Ceddanne Rafaela, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Oliver Dunn, Chandler Simpson because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
